propositions: The packaged code-review guide (src/rebar/_guides/passing-code-review.md lines 112-114) contains stale documentation that incorrectly instructs contributors to ping maintainers for coverage-gap blocks instead of using self-service recheck-review.
Coverage-gap -1 votes are infrastructure vetoes, not code findings, and can be re-triggered by contributors via comment recheck-review on the change.
The guide's coverage-gap bullet must be updated to name recheck-review as the primary self-service trigger and document its symmetry with recheck (CI re-trigger).
rebar explain review is the primary discoverable entry point for the Gerrit LLM-Review gate onramp and the stale guidance actively misdirects contributors away from self-service.
